approval: User approved signature legendary items, earned artisan bonuses, named mythical makers, and guild/raid benefits.

rules.coverage: Every configured dungeon/raid finale receives a legendary route; penultimate or memorable encounters can supply explicitly selected complementary routes.
rules.rarity: A route is available; exact core drop rates, quantities, resource costs and effect magnitudes are unratified.
rules.earning: Actual encounter loot, real inputs and successful city craft; no historical clear, mail mirror or order fabricates an award.
rules.artisan_reward: First qualifying completed design-family craft earns maker mastery once; useful later commissions can earn custom standing.
rules.legacy_policy: Existing uncapped earned boss legacies and raid5/10/dungeon1/2 additive five-attribute design remain separate.
rules.item_effects: Equipped exact-item effects; identical aura-family recipient effects follow explicit nonmultiplying rules, distinct compatible effects remain independent.
rules.native_admission: No item/spell/property/recipe IDs, final-encounter mapping, event hooks or output effects are admitted by this catalogue.

candidates.item_mechanic: Focused attacks build a brief opening against the same enemy.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Cunning Maker: precision finishes for agile weapons.
candidates.shared_benefit: A marked opening gives nearby group members a short precision benefit.

candidates.item_mechanic: Defending an ally builds a short physical ward.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Stonewright: defensive finishing for heavy armor.
candidates.shared_benefit: A completed ward briefly steadies nearby allies against physical pressure.

candidates.item_mechanic: Blocking or parrying strengthens the wearer's next defensive action.
candidates.shared_benefit: Guild unlock: an imperial armor workshop pattern, requiring native skill and real inputs.

candidates.item_mechanic: Interrupting a hostile spell strengthens the next compatible spell.
candidates.shared_benefit: A successful hostile interrupt gives the group a brief anti-magic ward.

candidates.item_mechanic: Useful attacks against undead charge a restorative pulse.
candidates.shared_benefit: Charged pulses support nearby allies; self-inflicted or friendly events do not charge them.

candidates.item_mechanic: Sustained pressure against a real enemy builds a short martial flourish.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Bladebound: physical weapon and glove finishing.
candidates.shared_benefit: The flourish briefly rewards coordinated attacks by the current group.

candidates.item_mechanic: Movement during active combat prepares a frost ward.
candidates.shared_benefit: Releasing the ward briefly protects nearby allies against frost.

candidates.item_mechanic: Resisting hostile control prepares a short endurance benefit.
candidates.shared_benefit: Guild unlock: a northern endurance workshop pattern.

candidates.item_mechanic: Fire exposure charges a fiery cleave; the wielder carries a fire-resistance aura.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Emberforger: fire-resistant armor and fiery weapon finishes.
candidates.shared_benefit: Nearby group members receive the equipped relic's fire-resistance aura.

candidates.item_mechanic: Successful defensive actions prepare a precise retaliation.
candidates.shared_benefit: A retaliation briefly strengthens nearby allies' resolve against fear.

candidates.item_mechanic: Responding to hostile magic prepares a small adaptive defensive benefit.
candidates.shared_benefit: Group benefits follow the last qualified hostile school; no blanket immunity.

candidates.item_mechanic: Different hostile magic schools build a short prismatic ward.
candidates.shared_benefit: A completed ward shares a brief portion of its protection with nearby allies.

candidates.item_mechanic: Complementary wearers reward alternating martial and magical contributions.
candidates.shared_benefit: The pair's resonance needs two distinct eligible wearers in one actual group.

candidates.item_mechanic: Useful hostile spell hits reveal a short opportunity for the wielder.
candidates.shared_benefit: Revealed opportunities briefly support nearby spellcasters.

candidates.item_mechanic: Under hostile magical pressure, useful casting prepares a short recovery benefit.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Astral Tailor: caster-leg and robe finishing.
candidates.shared_benefit: Guild unlock: an astral cloth workshop technique.

candidates.item_mechanic: Useful healing prepares a small water-themed defensive pulse.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Tidewright: healer-compatible mail and cloth finishes.
candidates.shared_benefit: The pulse benefits nearby injured allies and does not charge on overhealing alone.

candidates.item_mechanic: A sequence of useful spells charges a fiery flourish.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Phoenix Maker: compatible fire/caster weapon finishing.
candidates.shared_benefit: The flourish briefly improves the current group's spell discipline.

candidates.item_mechanic: Pressure on a real enemy prepares a short evasive flourish.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Felsteel Master: agile martial weapon finishing.
candidates.shared_benefit: Qualified paired attacks briefly assist nearby melee allies.

candidates.item_mechanic: Hostile shadow pressure charges a short protective dawn pulse.
candidates.shared_benefit: The pulse protects the current group without granting immunity or resurrection.

candidates.item_mechanic: Successful defensive actions build a short discipline benefit.
candidates.artisan_distinction: Master of the Tempered Line: defensive leg finishing.
candidates.shared_benefit: The discipline benefit briefly supports nearby tanks and guards.

candidates.item_mechanic: A periodic frost ward releases a protective pulse when broken by hostile damage.
candidates.shared_benefit: Nearby raid/group members receive the pulse's frost protection.

candidates.item_mechanic: Useful casting builds a ward against hostile frost and shadow.
